title: Docs URL index
description: core/docs-index.json — the sendbird.com/docs pages in this plugin's scope, trimmed from Sendbird's published llms.txt by tools/curated/build-docs-index.sh. Agents look a page up here and WebFetch that exact URL instead of constructing one. Entries are sorted by url and unique by url. platform is the plugin platform (ios / android / js, or common for product-level pages); docsPlatform is the platform segment of the docs URL (ios, android, javascript, react-native, ios-uikit, swiftui, android-view, jetpack-compose, react), null when the URL has none; section is the first path segment after docsPlatform, or the page slug when the page sits directly under it.
